paragraph: visible_report means: True = saved report has a worksheet and at least one completed known-cost position (shown as a visible completed-position result, not an account claim); False = saved but not that result; absent = pre-field compatibility, treated as unknown. The exact stored value is copied through save, JSON serialize, Store retrieve, frontend hydration, and reopen. Explicit False survives. Defaults apply only when the field is absent; absent never becomes True and is not materialised as False onto an old report. Gates and compare treat unknown as not-True.
